# Project Meru

> Project Meru is an **open-source initiative** that hosts software across categories.
> **Sumeru** is the first product: a modular ERP framework written in Go.

**Status (Sumeru): pre-alpha.** The framework runs and the lead-to-cash flow works end to end, but
there is no tagged release, no upgrade path between versions, and no test suite on the business addons.

- Hub: https://projectmeru.github.io/
- Sumeru: https://projectmeru.github.io/sumeru/
- Docs: https://projectmeru.github.io/sumeru/docs/
- Code: https://github.com/ProjectMeru
- Licence (Sumeru): dual licensed. Community edition under Apache 2.0; enterprise edition under a commercial
  licence (the enterprise edition does not exist as a product yet)

## Naming

- **Project Meru**: the organisation / initiative and this website's root.
- **Sumeru**: the ERP framework. In code, CLI, config and Go modules you will only ever see `sumeru`.

## Sumeru - key facts

- **Language / runtime:** Go 1.26+. Requires PostgreSQL and nothing else: no Node, no Docker, no
  message broker, no cache, no external job queue.
- **Repository layout:** three `replace`-linked Go modules. `sumeru` (the core framework),
  `sumeru_addons` (the standard business addons), `sumeru_custom_addons` (your workspace, and the
  module you actually run the server from).
- **Kernel packages:** `core/orm`, `core/module`, `core/engine`, `core/server`, `core/event`,
  `core/sdk`, `core/scheduler`, `core/applog`, `core/cache`, `core/importgen`.
- **Addon anatomy:** `manifest.json` (name, version, depends, data), `init.go`, `models/*.go`,
  `views/*.xml`, `security/security.xml` and `security/sys.access.csv`, optional `data/*.xml`.
- **A model** is metadata: a `ModelName()` and a `Fields()` slice, which the kernel turns into a
  real PostgreSQL table. Records at runtime are maps, not structs.
- **Addons never import each other.** They integrate through an event bus (`record.created`,
  `record.updated`, `cron.tick`) plus registry lookups. The manifest's `depends` array drives
  install order only.
- **API:** JSON-RPC at `POST /api/rpc` with API-key authentication.
- **Isolation:** one server serves one database. Multi-company is supported; it is **not** multi-tenant.

## Addons that exist today

Core: `base`, `mail`, `automation` (partial), `sumeru_ai` (placeholder).

Standard: `contacts`, `product`, `crm`, `sale` (partial), `sale_crm`, `account`, `purchase` (partial),
`hr` (partial).

**Works today:** Lead -> won -> quotation -> sales order -> customer invoice -> posted journal entries.

**Does not exist yet:** taxes, payments, computed order totals, inventory, manufacturing, reports,
automated tests on the business addons.
